abilities.name: Dawnbearing Songbird
_curatorNotes: genshin-db stub artifacts fixed: behavior 'persistent' → 'instant' and the spurious 'summon' tag removed. Aedon is a one-shot dash-strike (Tap: dashes forward; Hold: aim then dash), not a lingering summon/field — KQM quickguide + Fandom confirm no persistent entity.

On-cast Geo DMG unauthored (no FrameMap source — no gcsim, char stays FRAMELESS_EXEMPT). Sidecar Press DMG TL10 = 868.61% EM + 434.3% DEF; Hold DMG TL10 = 1085.76% EM + 542.88% DEF. Generates ~4.5 Geo particles on hit (Icy Veins / genshin.gg) — particle gen isn't modeled by the effect schema.
Casting this skill also grants the team the Lightkeeper's Oath buff — authored on the Torchforger's Covenant passive with an onCast trigger (fires on skill OR burst).
abilities.description:
Summons the trusty messenger bird, "Aedon." Different effects are produced depending on whether the skill is Tapped or Held.

Tap
Aedon dashes towards enemies in front, dealing Geo DMG to enemies it comes into contact with.

Hold
Enter aiming mode, and command Aedon to dash towards opponents being aimed at, dealing Geo DMG to opponents it comes into contact with.

abilities.name: Shadowless Reflection
abilities.caveat: On cast, Illuga's party gains Nightingale's Song for 20s: while it lasts, the active character's Geo attacks (Normal/Charged/Plunging/Skill/Burst) deal extra damage based on Illuga's Elemental Mastery, with a much larger bonus on damage that triggers a Lunar-Crystallize reaction (Lunar-Crystallize = a Geo reaction against a Moon-charged aura). This damage boost is a per-hit flat add scoped to Geo damage, which the tool cannot show as a stat buff — treat it as an on-demand Geo damage amplifier. The team crit and Elemental Mastery buffs it grants ARE shown (see Torchforger's Covenant).
_curatorNotes: genshin-db stub artifact fixed: behavior 'stance' → 'instant' (removed the stance 'duration' field). Haunted Night's Oriole-Song is a 20s buff STATE, not a weapon stance: it does not convert Illuga's normals and it persists while Illuga is OFF-field (stacks are consumed by nearby ACTIVE party members' Geo hits). KQM quickguide: 'No stance/field mode.' The 20s window surfaces via the Torchforger's Covenant / C4 buff bars (each duration 20).

Nightingale's Song DMG bonus deliberately NOT authored as an effect. It is a per-hit FLAT damage add scoped to the Geo element (base TL10 = 60.5% of Illuga's EM; Lunar-Crystallize TL10 = 406.7% of EM; A4 adds a further 7/14/24% EM base and 48/96/160% EM Lunar-Crystallize for 1/2/3 Hydro-or-Geo party members). The Stat vocabulary has no element-scoped flat-DMG key (flat-DMG stats are attack-class-scoped: normalFlatDmg…burstFlatDmg; lunarCrystallizeFlatDmg exists but authoring only the Lunar-Crystallize sliver while the far-more-common base Geo portion stays unmodelable would misrepresent the kit). Stubbed with a user caveat instead — see flags.

On-cast AoE Geo DMG unauthored (no FrameMap source). Sidecar Skill DMG TL10 = 1488.96% EM + 744.48% DEF. Burst grants 21 base Nightingale's Song stacks + 5 per Geo Construct on the field at cast or created during the window, max +15 (so up to 36 stacks). Duration 20s, CD 15s, energy 60 — all confirmed vs sidecar.
Casting this burst grants the team Lightkeeper's Oath — authored on Torchforger's Covenant (onCast trigger, fires on skill or burst).
abilities.description:
Light the lamp, dealing AoE Geo DMG, and gain Haunted Night's Oriole-Song effect for 20s. When this effect is active, Illuga gains 21 stacks of **Nightingale's Song**. When Normal Attacks, Charged Attacks, Plunging Attacks, Elemental Skills, and Elemental Bursts of nearby active party members deal Geo DMG to opponents, 1 stack of Nightingale's Song is consumed to increase the DMG dealt. Increase in DMG is based on Illuga's Elemental Mastery. If DMG is inflicted by Lunar-Crystallize, DMG dealt will increase further.
When Geo DMG dealt in this manner hits multiple opponents, multiple stacks of Nightingale's Song will be consumed, depending on how many opponents are hit.

Additionally, if there are Geo Constructs created by nearby party members on the battlefield while Illuga unleashes his Elemental Burst, or when nearby party members create Geo Constructs while Haunted Night's Oriole-Song is active, every Geo Construct on the battlefield will allow Illuga to gain 5 additional stacks of Nightingale's Song. Within 20s after unleashing his Elemental Burst, Illuga can gain a maximum of 15 additional stacks of Nightingale's Song this way.

When all stacks of Nightingale's Song have been consumed, or when the state's duration ends, the Haunted Night's Oriole-Song effect will end.

passives.name: Torchforger's Covenant
passives.caveat: The CRIT Rate and CRIT DMG bonuses apply only to the party's Geo damage. The +50 Elemental Mastery bonus requires the party to have reached the Moonsign: Ascendant Gleam level (roughly, two or more Nod-Krai / Moonsign characters).
_curatorNotes: Ascension 1 passive (icy-veins / genshin.gg). Trigger set to onCast with no ability filter so it fires after either the Elemental Skill OR the Elemental Burst (fixed the inherited 'manual' placeholder). Target 'teamExcludingSelf' — the text says OTHER nearby party members gain Lightkeeper's Oath; Illuga does not buff himself here.

CRIT DMG portion authored as geoCritDmg (Gorou C6 precedent — 'increases the CRIT DMG of party members' Geo DMG'). CRIT Rate portion authored as generic critRate because there is no geoCritRate stat in the vocabulary; the Geo-only scoping is surfaced in the user caveat. EM portion is a plain (non-Geo-scoped) EM buff.

C6 (Nightmare Orioles) enhances these totals to +10% CR / +30% geoCD / +80 EM — modeled via constellationScaling (value REPLACES the base, matching the in-game 'enhanced to' wording, not additive). The C6 node therefore carries no standalone buff effects.

Moonsign: Ascendant Gleam EM buff gated on teamFaction faction:moonsign min:2 (Lauma/Flins Ascendant-Gleam precedent). NOTE: Illuga's own utility passive raises the party's Moonsign by 1, so the true activation threshold may be lower than a bare min:2 count — flagged for Nate.
passives.description:
After unleashing Elemental Skill **Dawnbearing Songbird** or Elemental Burst **Shadowless Reflection**, other nearby party members will gain the Lightkeeper's Oath effect for 20s: For Geo DMG dealt to opponents, CRIT Rate increases by 5% and CRIT DMG increases by 10%.

Moonsign: Ascendant Gleam 
Party members affected by the Lightkeeper's Oath effect have their Elemental Mastery increased by 50.

passives.name: Demonhunter's Dusk
passives.caveat: Further increases the Nightingale's Song damage bonus based on how many Hydro or Geo characters are in the party (Illuga counts). Like the base Nightingale's Song bonus, this is a per-hit flat damage add on Geo attacks and is not shown as a stat — see the Elemental Burst.
_curatorNotes: Ascension 4 passive. The two inherited 'damage / target: enemy' effects from the genshin-db stub were REMOVED — they misrepresented the mechanic (this is not autonomous damage Illuga deals; it augments the active character's own Geo hits via Nightingale's Song, an element-scoped per-hit flat-DMG add with no matching Stat primitive — see the burst's curator note).

TL-scaled values at party count 1/2/3 Hydro-or-Geo: base +7%/14%/24% of Illuga's EM; Lunar-Crystallize +48%/96%/160% of EM. Not authored as effects for the reason above; captured here + in the burst caveat/flags.
passives.description: **Nightingale's Song**'s effects are enhanced: When there are 1/2/3 Hydro or Geo characters in the party, Nightingale's Song will further increase DMG. Increase in DMG is equal to 7%/14%/24% of Illuga's Elemental Mastery. If this aforementioned DMG is inflicted by a Lunar-Crystallize reaction, increase in DMG is equal to 48%/96%/160% of Illuga's Elemental Mastery.

constellations.name: Vigilant Sentinel
_curatorNotes: +12 Energy to Illuga when he triggers a Geo-related (Crystallize / Lunar-Crystallize) reaction on the field, once per 15s. Authored as an energy effect with onReaction trigger + procCooldown 15 (Flins C1 energy-on-reaction precedent). Source defaults to 'self' (only Illuga's reactions), matching 'triggers ... on the field'.
constellations.description: After Illuga triggers a Geo-related Reaction on the field, he will regain 12 Elemental Energy. This effect can be triggered at most once every 15s.

constellations.name: Elk With Fanged Antlers
_curatorNotes: Aedon strike: 400% of Illuga's EM + 200% of his DEF, single-target Geo, counted as Burst DMG. Added the DEF portion (flatScaling def 200) and Geo element that the stub dropped. Trigger left 'manual': it fires once per 7 Nightingale's Song stacks consumed during the burst window — there is no primitive for 'per-N-stacks-consumed', and there is no gcsim/FrameMap source for its timing. Real off-field damage (Aedon strikes autonomously while Illuga is off-field), so it registers as a C2 off-field-DMG capability.
constellations.description: When Elemental Burst **Shadowless Reflection**'s Haunted Night's Oriole-Song effect is active, for every 7 stacks of **Nightingale's Song** consumed, Illuga will summon Aedon, dealing a single instance of Geo DMG to 1 nearby opponent. The DMG dealt is based on 400% of Illuga's Elemental Mastery and 200% of his DEF. This DMG is considered Elemental Burst DMG.

constellations.description:
Enhances the Lightkeeper's Oath effect of the Ascension Talent **Torchforger's Covenant**: For Geo DMG dealt to opponents, CRIT Rate is increased by 10%, CRIT DMG is increased by 30%.

Moonsign: Ascendant Gleam:
When characters are affected by Lightkeeper's Oath, Elemental Mastery is increased by 80.
You must first unlock the Ascension Talent "Torchforger's Covenant."
